definitions.rationale: This equation defines the fresh verification symbol cubeOf introduced by VERIFICATION-SYNTAX as integer cubing.
This is the equality-guarded base equation defining the fresh verification summary cubeSearch.
definitions.text:
rule cubeSearch(A, I) => true
    requires cubeOf(I) ==Int A

definitions.rationale: This is the greater-than-guarded base equation defining the fresh verification summary cubeSearch.
definitions.text:
rule cubeSearch(A, I) => false
    requires cubeOf(I) >Int A

definitions.rationale: This is the less-than-guarded recurrence defining the fresh verification summary cubeSearch at the next candidate.
definitions.text:
rule cubeSearch(A, I) => cubeSearch(A, I +Int 1)
    requires cubeOf(I) <Int A

definitions.rationale: This is the negative-input guarded equation defining the fresh verification summary isCubeInt by sign normalization and cubeSearch.
definitions.text:
rule isCubeInt(A) => cubeSearch(0 -Int A, 0)
    requires A <Int 0

definitions.rationale: This is the nonnegative-input guarded equation defining the fresh verification summary isCubeInt by cubeSearch.
This equation defines the fresh nullary verification symbol iscubeClosure as the named closure proof term.
definitions.text:
rule iscubeClosure
    => closureVal(
         "a",
         If(
           Compare(Name("a"), CmpOp("<", Int(0))),
           Assign(Name("a"), UnaryOp("-", Name("a"))),
           .Stmts)
         Assign(Name("candidate"), Int(0))
         While(
           Compare(
             BinOp(
               "*",
               BinOp("*", Name("candidate"), Name("candidate")),
               Name("candidate")),
             CmpOp("<", Name("a"))),
           AugAssign(Name("candidate"), "+", Int(1)))
         Return(
           Compare(
             BinOp(
               "*",
               BinOp("*", Name("candidate"), Name("candidate")),
               Name("candidate")),
             CmpOp("==", Name("a")))),
         0)

proved_derived_lemmas.rationale: The installed bridge has the identical reachability statement previously proved as CONNECTION.search-loop against verification-base-kompiled, before connection-rule.k is compiled; the variable set, guards, continuation, and complete cell transition are unchanged.
proved_derived_lemmas.text:
rule
    <k>
      #while(
        Compare(
          BinOp(
            "*",
            BinOp("*", Name("candidate"), Name("candidate")),
            Name("candidate")),
          CmpOp("<", Name("a"))),
        AugAssign(Name("candidate"), "+", Int(1)))
      ~> (Return(
           Compare(
             BinOp(
               "*",
               BinOp("*", Name("candidate"), Name("candidate")),
               Name("candidate")),
             CmpOp("==", Name("a")))) .Stmts)
      ~> #endcall
      =>
      cubeSearch(A, C)
    </k>
    <env> 1 => 0 </env>
    <scopes>
      ( SC:Map
        1 |-> scope(
               "a"         |-> A:Int
               "candidate" |-> C:Int,
               parent(0))
      =>
        SC
      )
    </scopes>
    <scopeLoc> 2 => 1 </scopeLoc>
    <heap> .Map </heap>
    <heapLoc> 0 </heapLoc>
    <stack> ListItem(frame(.K, 0, 1)) => .List </stack>
    <ret> noRet </ret>
    <exc> NoExc </exc>
    <exit-code> 0 </exit-code>
    [priority(40)]

source_rules.rationale: This simplification states an additional fact relating externally defined integer equality and ordering to cubeSearch; it does not define a fresh symbol on its left-hand side and was not proved separately before use.
source_rules.text:
rule ((I *Int I) *Int I ==Int A) => cubeSearch(A, I)
    requires notBool ((I *Int I) *Int I <Int A)
    [simplification]

source_rules.rationale: This simplification states a deletion/update fact about the externally defined Map operation; it defines no fresh verification symbol and was already present in the definition used by the Stage 1 proofs.
source_rules.text:
rule ((1 |-> S:Scope) REST:Map) [ 1 <- undef ] => REST
    requires notBool 1 in_keys(REST)
    [simplification]
